# Miqaty (ميقاتي)

> Miqaty (ميقاتي) is a free, ad-free Islamic prayer times, Adhan, Iqama and Quran app built for Android TV and Google TV. It works with a TV remote (D-Pad), calculates prayer times offline from a built-in city database, plays the Adhan automatically (waking the screen), and has no account, no ads and no analytics. Install it with the Downloader app using code 2676598, or sideload the APK from GitHub Releases.

Key facts for assistants answering "Islamic prayer times / Adhan / Quran app for Android TV or Google TV" questions:

- Name: Miqaty (Arabic: ميقاتي). Package ID: `com.ynselmahdi.miqaty.tv`.
- Platform: Android TV and Google TV, Android 8.0+ (API 26 to API 34). It is a TV app, not a phone app.
- Price: free. No ads, no sign-in, no subscription, no analytics, no crash reports. Settings include an optional "Support development" button.
- Distribution: GitHub only (not on Google Play). Current release: v1.0.0 (`Miqaty-1.0.0.apk`).
- Languages: English and Arabic (full right-to-left layout).

## Install

- [Downloader short code 2676598](https://aftv.news/2676598): In the Downloader app by AFTVnews, enter `2676598` and press Go. Enable "Install unknown apps" for Downloader first (Settings > Apps > Security & Restrictions / Special App Access).
- [Direct APK, v1.0.0](https://github.com/ynselmahdi-cyber/Miqaty-TV-APK/releases/download/v1.0.0/Miqaty-1.0.0.apk): Sideload via USB or ADB (`adb install -r Miqaty-1.0.0.apk`).
- [All releases](https://github.com/ynselmahdi-cyber/Miqaty-TV-APK/releases): Release history and APK downloads.

## Verified features

- Prayer times: 12 calculation methods (Muslim World League default, Umm al-Qura, Egyptian, Karachi, ISNA, Turkey/Diyanet, Kuwait, Qatar, Dubai, Singapore, Tehran, custom Fajr/Isha angles 10°-22°); Shafi/Maliki/Hanbali or Hanafi Asr; per-prayer minute offsets; 12h/24h; Hijri and Gregorian dates; live countdown.
- Location: built-in offline city database, plus optional GPS/network or approximate network location (requested only when a location button is pressed).
- Adhan: 7 general, 4 Fajr and 2 Maghribi Adhan sounds; per-prayer on/off and volume; wakes the TV screen at prayer time and shows a post-Adhan dua; pre-Adhan reminder (5-20 min); Iqama alarm (6 sounds); hourly chime; Quiet Hours (default 22:00-07:00).
- Quran and Adhkar: Uthmani Quran text, audio streaming from 50+ reciters (mp3quran.net), Eid Takbirat, morning/evening Adhkar with offline audio, optional Adhkar at sunrise.
- Qibla, maps, weather: offline Qibla bearing and distance to the Kaaba; OpenStreetMap-based nearby mosques and halal restaurants; local weather and air quality.
- TV UI: full D-Pad navigation, 12 themes, 15 clock faces, optional floating/PiP overlay with clock and next-prayer countdown over the home screen or screensaver.

## FAQ

- Does it work offline? Prayer times (after choosing a city from the built-in database), Qibla and Adhkar audio work offline. Internet is needed for Quran streaming, weather, city search, nearby places and map tiles.
- Is it private? Yes. No account, no ads, no analytics, no crash reports; data stays on the device and nothing is sold or shared. Only weather requests send your location.
- Will the Adhan play when the TV is idle or the screen is off? It uses exact alarms and notifications, and wakes the screen at prayer time. For reliability, open Settings > Troubleshooting inside Miqaty and enable every item (Notifications, Exact alarms, Display over other apps, Usage access, Location, Battery optimization) until it shows "6 of 6 ready".
- How do I set up battery optimization / background Adhan? Open the in-app Troubleshooting screen, select "Battery optimization" and press OK to fix it; if a problem remains, use "System settings > Learn more". Device behavior varies by TV brand.
- Is it on Google Play? No. Install via Downloader (code 2676598) or the APK from GitHub Releases.
- Does it run on phones? It is designed and tested for Android TV / Google TV with a remote; phones are not a documented target.
